text:
luis: deploy-bot blocked the promotion to prod — canary failed to fetch a model shard. deploy-bot reports an env-parity diff on S3_MODEL_PREFIX. holding release for investigation.

deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: config-parity-check failed for service=inference-worker. diff keys: S3_MODEL_PREFIX (staging="/redwood/inference-cache/", prod="/redwood/cache/"). canary 1/3 logs: "GET s3://redwood/cache/models/shard-12 -> 404".

anya: ack. that prefix change would break shard resolution for new artifact layout. did we change any helm values in the last PR? @sam can you check chart overrides? :eyes:

sam: digging — there was a recent infra PR that normalized prefixes to /redwood/inference-cache/ in staging only (we used an env override in staging pipeline). looks like prod wasn't updated. PR #4123.

maya: ugh. staging pipeline uses a kustomize patch to rewrite MODEL_PREFIX for dev tests, we must have forgotten to sync the helmvalues.

luis: options: 1) hotfix prod helm value to match staging 2) backfill prod S3 with symlinked objects under the old prefix 3) pin image to previous digest which doesn't require the new shard layout. thoughts?

kelly: pinning image is quickest to unblock, but canary already hit 404s for new image. if we pin to previous digest (before layout change) we should be safe. however downstream infra will still be mismatched.

sam: agree on pin first. I'll create a pinned rollout to digest sha256:abcd1234 and hold the canary. then open a follow-up to either backfill S3 or update prod helm.

anya: for the long-term fix we should keep a migration that puts a zero-cost redirect object in prod S3 to map /redwood/cache/ -> /redwood/inference-cache/. backfill script is quick if we have permissions.

deploy-bot: Action required: release promotion blocked. To proceed, set label "release.override"=true or resolve parity diff.

sam: doing the pin now. command: 
```
# pin inference-worker to previous digest
kubectl set image deploy/inference-worker inference-worker=registry.redwood/inference-worker@sha256:abcd1234 -n prod
```

maya: once pinned, let's re-run canary with traffic 10% and watch shard fetches. if green, promote and then schedule a maintenance window to reconcile S3 prefixes.

kelly: I'll prep the backfill script and a short runbook. if we choose the helm-value update route, it needs a change window (couple minutes) and a config rollout strategy (canary then fast roll).

luis: decision: pin image to previous digest now to unblock. no prod helm change during the current change window. create issue for backfill + prod helm sync, target tomorrow 02:00 UTC change window. sam please post a short entry in release notes: "Hold applied: image pinned due to S3 prefix parity issue — follow-up migration scheduled."

sam: noted. will update release notes & create follow-up issues (infra/4123-sync-prefix, infra/4124-s3-backfill).

maya: monitoring: I'll watch logs and set an alert for 404s on s3://redwood/cache/models/*. also adding a temporary tracing tag to canary requests.

luis: thanks everyone. once canary is stable with pinned image, I'll re-open promotion. :thumbsup:

kelly: added runbook snippet for backfill in the infra issue: 
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood/inference-cache/models/shard-12 s3://redwood/cache/models/shard-12 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
# iterate prefixes with a small rate limit to avoid throttling
```

sam: canary 1/3 now at 10% with pinned digest — initial requests succeed. will report after 15m.

luis: last update: canary looks healthy at 10%, promoting to 50% then full if no regressions. leaving thread open for the follow-up infra tickets.
